brief: The canvas displays a breathtaking, multi-component steampunk sculpture built around a central, rotating cube. Deep emerald glass tracery and tarnished copper splines orbit this core, giving the impression of intricate celestial machinery. The glass itself is luminous, featuring visible internal energy veins and crystalline latticework. These internal structures exhibit vibrant, pulsating deep bioluminescent patterns that slowly appear to grow and flow through the components. The entire assembly rotates and glows with a constant, captivating display of artificial life.
